title: 第8章 炁字轮
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

服下幻形丹的和铃，找了身朴素的衣裳换上，偷溜下了混元峰。

宗门内人来人往，讨论着今天的喜事。

“夜师兄真要和程芰荷成亲了呀？”

“也不知道哪冒出来这么个人，以后就是夜师兄的道侣了……”

“哼，拿自己的金丹换了这门亲事，她简直愚蠢，连成天追在夜弦身后的和铃师姐都知晓，金丹比男人重要，她真是连和铃师姐都不如！”

和铃看向说话的女弟子，什么叫“连和铃都不如”？

真会说话啊。

和铃垂着眸，低调从聊天的弟子身旁走过。

路上人越来越少，她故意等在山脚前，果然，没多久就有一个提着食桶的男弟子朝这边走来。

和铃迎面走过去，向对方施了一礼，目光落在食桶上，“师兄没去秋云峰吃酒吗？我看其他人都去山上观礼看热闹了。”

男弟子语气多有抱怨，“还不是我资历浅，得领了这任务，去给山上看井的风狸兽送晚膳嘛。”

“行了师妹，我也不和你多聊了，饭送晚了那风狸兽又要闹脾气，明天就不给人打水了。”

和铃笑着说道：“不如我替师兄去送饭吧。”

“你替我？”男弟子这才认真打量起面前的少女来，一张清秀的脸没什么特色，就是笑起来还蛮令人感到亲近的。

和铃点点头，“是啊，我这人不喜欢热闹，喜欢清静，而且我也不喝酒，去了也融入不进去。”

男弟子面露欣喜，“那就有劳师妹了，今日师妹帮了我一个忙，日后若有需要帮助的，尽管来寻我。”

他大气地做出承诺。

将食桶交到和铃的手上后，就迫不及待往秋云峰的方向跑了。

今天可是夜弦师兄的结侣大典，不仅有梁真君主持仪式，听说混元峰的明瑟真君、一尘峰的微尘真君还有宗主都会去观礼，就算是远远瞻仰一下这些大人物的尊容，也是天大的福气呀。

那愣头青师妹不懂这个道理，倒是让他捡了个便宜。

“诶，忘了问她名字了......”

“算了，这不重要，秋云峰的喜事才重要。”

......

风狸兽是被宗主正式授了职位的看井官。

Page (1/3)

After taking the Transformation Pill, He Ling found some simple clothes to change into, and sneaked down Hunyuan Peak.

People in the sect came and went, discussing today's happy events.

"Senior Brother Ye is really going to get married to Cheng Qianhe?"

"I don't know where such a person came from. From now on, he will be Senior Brother Ye's Taoist companion..."

"Hmph, she is so stupid to exchange her golden elixir for this marriage. Even Senior Sister Heling, who has been chasing Ye Xian all day long, knows that golden elixir is more important than men. She is really not as good as Senior Sister Heling!"

He Ling looked at the female disciple who was speaking. What does it mean to be "not even as good as He Ling"?

He really knows how to talk.

He Ling lowered his eyes and walked past the chatting disciple in a low-key manner.

There were fewer and fewer people on the road, so she deliberately waited at the foot of the mountain. Sure enough, not long after, a male disciple carrying a food bucket came towards her.

He Ling walked over to him and saluted him, his eyes falling on the food bucket, "Senior brother, didn't you go to Qiuyun Peak to have a drink? I think everyone else went to the mountain to watch the ceremony and watch the fun."

The male disciple's tone was full of complaints, "It's not like I'm a junior, so I have to accept this task and deliver dinner to the Fengli beast who is guarding the well on the mountain."

"Okay, junior sister, I won't talk to you any more. The meal was delivered late and the raccoon beast is going to lose its temper again and won't fetch water for you tomorrow."

He Ling smiled and said, "Why don't I go deliver the food for senior brother?"

"Are you taking my place?" The male disciple then carefully looked at the girl in front of him. Her delicate face had no features, but her smile was quite approachable.

He Ling nodded, "Yeah, I don't like the excitement, I like quietness, and I don't drink, so I won't fit in if I go there."

The male disciple's face showed joy, "Then I'd like to thank you, Junior Sister. Today, Junior Sister helped me a favor. If you need help in the future, feel free to come to me."

He made the promise grandly.

After handing the food bucket to He Ling's hand, he couldn't wait to run towards Qiuyun Peak.

Today is Senior Brother Yexian's marriage ceremony. Not only will Liang Zhenjun preside over the ceremony, I heard that Zhenjun Mingse from Hunyuan Peak, Zhenjun Weichen from Yichen Peak, and the sect leaders will also attend the ceremony. Even if you can admire the appearance of these important people from a distance, it is a great blessing.

That stupid junior sister Qing didn't understand this truth, but he got an advantage.

"Hey, I forgot to ask her name..."

"Forget it, this is not important, Qiuyunfeng's happy event is important."

...

Fenglimon is a well guard who was officially awarded the position by the sect leader.
